title: AntiSoftlock
description: Prevents common Minecraft softlocks by detecting traps, redirecting unsafe respawns, and adding an /unstuck command for players.
body:
# AntiSoftlock

**AntiSoftlock** is a lightweight Paper plugin designed to prevent players from getting trapped in impossible-to-escape situations (*softlocks*).
It detects common Minecraft traps and exploits, automatically rescuing players or blocking the action before it happens.

## Features

* **Nether Roof Protection** – Blocks ender pearl teleports above Y=127.
* **Anti-Obsidian/Lava Death Loops** – Redirects unsafe respawns to a safe spot.
* **End Portal Bed Guard** – Stops setting spawn in portal rooms that trap you in the End.
* **Encase Detection** – Cancels ender pearls into sealed 2-block-high cages.
* **Lava Spawn Trap Prevention** – Ensures respawns aren’t inside lava pools.
* **Death Loop Watchdog** – Detects repeated deaths in the same spot and auto-rescues.
* **`/unstuck` Command** – Lets players safely teleport out of dangerous situations (configurable cooldown).

## Commands & Permissions

| Command    | Description                     | Permission             |
| ---------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `/unstuck` | Teleports player to a safe spot | `antisoftlock.unstuck` |
| *(auto)*   | Bypass all protections          | `antisoftlock.bypass`  |

## Configuration

* Toggle each protection individually
* Enable/disable pearl refunds
* Adjustable safe respawn scan radius
* Customize `/unstuck` cooldown

## Why Use It?

Even in a sandbox game like Minecraft, it’s possible for players to become permanently stuck without admin help.
**AntiSoftlock** ensures your players can always keep playing — no rage-quitting over traps or broken spawns.
